usedFor: Support teams use Trengo to keep people on file with “Create a profile”, “Create a note” and “Update a profile”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in WooCommerce, then “Attach a contact” in Trengo
bestTemplate.why: A new customer can be attached as a contact in Trengo.

watchOut: “Delete a profile” removes a profile by ID, so keep it behind an approval step.
